newsitem.title: USA: Audiovox extends debt exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Audiovox extends debt exchange offer.

text.p: Audiovox Corp said on Tuesday it extended its exchange offer for its $65 million outstanding of 6-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2001 for Class A stock to November 25.
The offer was set to expire on November 19. Audiovox has offered to exchange 165 shares of common stock for each $1,000 principal amount of the debentures.
The offer was subject to shareholder approval at a meeting now rescheduled for 1000 EDT on November 25.
Majority shareholder John Shalam has indicated he would vote his shares in favor of the offer, Audiovox said.
